frames.title: A Salesforce step on a working connection: Pennie Salesforce
A Salesforce step on a connection with a problem: Achieve Salesforce

decisions.decision: On the canvas, a step's Connection field is the app's dropdown with the chosen connection's name, with only "Acts as <who>" under it; nothing about status on a healthy day. A connection with a problem adds one red line saying what is wrong and where it is fixed, "Needs reconnecting on the Connections page", its last two words a dark underlined link to that page.
decisions.why: Rounds 8 and 8b: who the step acts as is the fact a builder needs; a healthy status is noise. Round 24: the problem is fixed on the Connections page, so the line says so and links there.
decisions.check: The Connection field is a dropdown reading the chosen connection's name with "Acts as <who>" under it and nothing else on a working connection; on a connection with a problem one more line reads "Needs reconnecting on the Connections page" in red (#B42318) at weight 500, holding one link reading Connections page that is dark (#1D212F), underlined and of normal weight (400).

decisions.decision: Blue is for buttons only; links are dark and underlined.
decisions.check: Nothing in the Connection field is coloured blue (#1B72BA) in its text or background outside a button, and every link in it is dark (#1D212F) and underlined.

decisions.decision: Red is only for something genuinely wrong.
decisions.check: Red (#B42318) appears in the step panel only on the line saying the connection has a problem.

decisions.decision: No line of text ends with a single word on its own line. A rule for all of Bidspoke's copy, made by Dan on 2026-10-20 in these rounds.
decisions.check: No block of text in the Connection field wraps so that its last line holds a single word (the other fields are the product's copy as it is today, not decided here).

idioms: The step panel is drawn inside a captured copy of the canvas at 1120 wide; the canvas, the panel's header and the other fields are the product as it is today, not decisions.
The Connections page link goes nowhere in the design; in the app it opens the Connections page.
